Ava (CEO): Heads-up @here: Founders sync Tuesday 10:00a PT (30m). We'll do concise updates + Q&A. Drop Qs below or add to the Miro: https://miro.com/app/board/uXjXXXXX — please submit by Friday EOD. :calendar:
Jordan (Product): Can we include a short customer story (3–4m)? I have a good candidate. cc @Ava
Marco (CTO): We'll add a 2m infra status + the incident recap from last week. Will share 1 slide.
Rina (People Ops): RSVP form: https://forms.gle/abc123 — indicate if you'll present a 1-min team highlight. :raised_hand:
Ava (CEO): Agenda (high level):
```
- 10m Founders update
- 8m Roadmap highlights (Jordan)
- 4m Infra & incident notes (Marco)
- 8m Q&A and asks
```
Please keep slides to 2 max and one takeaway per team.
Sam (Ops): Quick ask — teams doing production changes this week, paste a 1-line note here so we can flag during the sync.
DevRel: I'll drop a community highlight (1min).
Priya (Eng-SRE): FYI prod rollout for tokenizer optimization scheduled tomorrow 03:00 PT, low-risk but tagging here.
Jordan (Product): Thanks — adding the customer story to the deck. Also, can we surface the new billing pilot briefly?
Ava (CEO): Yes — 1 slide on the pricing pilot. Pls pin any hot Qs, we'll prioritize. If you want demo time, DM @Rina to get a speed slot. :sparkles:
Marco (CTO): :thumbsup:
--- (meeting happens) ---
Sam (Ops): Recording + notes posted: https://redwood.zoom.us/rec/abcd1234. TL;DR: 1) Hiring focus on infra & DX; 2) rolling out prefix-caching improvement next sprint; 3) pricing pilot starts next week.
Sam (Ops): Action items (short):
- Jordan: publish roadmap one-pager by Friday — owner: Jordan
- Marco: follow up on incident postmortem (internal) by Wed — owner: Marco
- Rina: collect volunteer presenters for next sync — owner: Rina
Ava (CEO): Great sync, thanks everyone. If your team has follow-ups, add them to the doc linked in the recording thread. :raised_hands:
